name: waiting_room
title: The Waiting Room
description: Rows of chairs facing a reception counter nobody has stood behind in years. The ticket display is stuck on zero.

writings.text: please remain seated until your copy is called

paintings.title: A harbour at dusk
paintings.text: Painted from a postcard someone described to me. I never saw the postcard. The boats are probably wrong.

paintings.title: Untitled field
paintings.text: If you can read this you are facing the wall. Turn around slowly. Nothing is there. Good.

notes.title: Survey log 1
notes.text: Day one. I measured the original rooms by the photo: 2.6 m ceilings, mustard carpet, the chevron wall. Out here the chairs are the right chairs but there are too many of them. The copy remembers 'waiting' better than it remembers rooms. - S.
